themes.name: Vision-language-action models and manipulation
themes.summary: These papers build vision-language-action policies and supporting modules for robot manipulation, proposing methods for reconciling new instructions during execution, bridging perception and action, regulating visual token influence, aligning tokenizer codebooks, certifying acceleration, and co-evolving orchestrators with policies. Several apply vision-language models to concrete tasks such as agricultural spraying, fruit harvesting, household assistance, and object-ownership grounding. They differ in whether they target the policy's internal representation, the inference pipeline, or the surrounding agentic system.

themes.name: Safety alignment, unlearning, and privacy
themes.summary: These papers examine the robustness and governance of safety mechanisms in language models and agents, covering privacy-preserving federated fine-tuning, credential-leakage benchmarks, adaptive guardrails, runtime verification, sparse fault analysis of safety parameters, and attacks that persist through the KV cache. Others study tamper resistance of open-weight models after information removal and how human review or reporting incentives shape safe decisions. They differ in focusing on training-time privacy, inference-time guardrails, or adversarial persistence.

themes.name: Robotic world models and 3D/4D reconstruction
themes.summary: These papers develop world models and reconstruction methods that build persistent spatial or geometric representations for robots and scenes, spanning factor and scene graph reviews, streaming panoramic and Gaussian reconstruction, directed temporal representations for control, and point cloud denoising. Others focus on CAD reconstruction, Bezier-curve topology reasoning, geometry-aware rendering, and diagnosing failure insensitivity in robot world models. They differ in whether they model dynamics and control, reconstruct geometry, or curate scene data.

themes.name: Self-improving and multi-agent LLM systems
themes.summary: These papers study agents and multi-agent systems that improve themselves through experience, covering the downstream utility of agent skills, self-improvement measurement, judgement engineering for coding, uncertainty estimation in parallel reasoning, and open-ended scientific discovery. Several automate the evolution of prompts, workflows, and even reinforcement-learning algorithms using search loops and meta-agents, while others build reusable code primitives or convert papers into trainable code. They differ in whether they measure, orchestrate, or automate agent improvement.

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference and long-context memory
themes.summary: These papers target the cost and reliability of long-context inference and persistent memory, proposing KV cache compression with temporal prefetching, sparse attention indexing, self-pruning attention, and dynamic computation for looped models. Others examine memory commit rules, cross-model drift, conflict resolution scoring, and evidence gaps in long-term memory question answering. They differ in optimizing attention and cache efficiency versus auditing the behavior of stored memory.

themes.name: Diffusion and flow models for reasoning and science
themes.summary: These papers apply diffusion and flow-matching generative models to scientific and reasoning problems, including EEG denoising, masked and continuous diffusion language models, CT reconstruction, jump-diffusion transition kernels, lattice gauge theory sampling, and inverse problems. Several introduce remasking, prompt noising, consistent distillation, and pooled representation autoencoders to improve sample quality or efficiency. They differ in whether they address language generation, physical simulation, or inverse-problem posterior sampling.

themes.name: LLM judge reliability and benchmark auditing
themes.summary: These papers audit the validity and reliability of evaluation pipelines, questioning preprocessing in forecasting benchmarks, blind spots in task verifiers, aggregate accuracy of LLM judges, and reporting conventions in quantum optimizer comparisons. Others examine the AI evaluation ecosystem, agentic harnesses on customer feedback, and coding-agent benchmarks versus real task flows, and propose conditional accuracy profiling and certified abstention for chain-of-thought verifiers. They differ in whether they diagnose judges, verifiers, or the broader benchmark ecosystem.

themes.name: Medical imaging foundation models
themes.summary: These papers build and adapt foundation models for medical imaging tasks such as report generation, longitudinal disease evolution, pathology calibration, brain MRI inpainting, and cardiac cine synthesis. Several address interpretability and personalization, using concept bottlenecks, model-agnostic learning from deployment experience, or audits of patient-specific forecasts, while others reconstruct CT from sparse X-rays. They differ in whether they adapt foundation models, generate missing modalities, or audit clinical personalization.

themes.name: Test-time scaling and RLVR for reasoning
themes.summary: These papers improve reasoning through inference-time and reinforcement-learning methods, proposing procedure-conditioned self-consistency, best-of-N evaluation, rollout allocation, and system switches between fast and deliberative models. Others focus on on-policy distillation, KL-regularized and off-policy-corrected policy optimization, and their effects on teaching skills versus knowledge. They differ in whether they scale test-time sampling, distill supervision, or correct asynchronous reinforcement learning.

themes.name: Graph RAG and structured-data foundation models
themes.summary: These papers build retrieval and reasoning systems over structured knowledge, including ontology-grounded GraphRAG for clinical risk, multimodal GraphRAG benchmarks, function-aware retrieval, and knowledge graphs for neuroscience targets, interatomic potentials, and machine-learning models. Others study visual document retrieval distillation, customer context graphs, attribution in retrieval-augmented models, and provably private tabular classification. They differ in whether they construct knowledge graphs, evaluate GraphRAG, or apply structured retrieval to a domain.

themes.name: Mechanistic interpretability of transformers
themes.summary: These papers probe the internal mechanisms of transformers, tracing structural information in AlphaFold, arithmetic scratchpads in tiny models, cross-model activation alignments, spatial induction heads, and multilingual multi-hop routing heads. Others study depth-wise magnitude in RoPE, negation behavior, identifiability of normalized attention, rank collapse, Gaussian equivalence, and activation patching damage. They differ in whether they identify circuits, analyze representational geometry, or test theoretical properties.

themes.name: Speech adaptation and emotion
themes.summary: These papers adapt and control speech models across domains and conditions, covering child ASR adaptation with adult retention, diarizer adaptation masking, privacy evaluation metrics, phoneme-guided initialization, lip-sync scoring, dialect-robust language models, and contextual biasing. Others address accented language identification, parameter-efficient Whisper adaptation, and activation steering for emotion in generated speech. They differ in whether they improve recognition robustness, control expressivity, or evaluate adaptation.

highlights.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
highlights.authors: Wei Huang, Bohan Zhang, Chenzhi Liu et al.
highlights.why: Strong result showing autoregressive pretraining unlocks long-context world-action models, advancing real-time robot control.
highlights.key_result: Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long; Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO, and real-world deployment includes 95% success on dynamic cup stacking.
evidence: Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long.
Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO.
Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where _0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials.

highlights.title: Inverting Multi-Vector Visual Document Indices
highlights.authors: Zhuchenyang Liu, Yao Zhang, Yu Xiao
highlights.why: Demonstrates that multi-vector visual document indices can be inverted to recover words and identify source pages, a significant privacy risk.
highlights.key_result: From the stored raw index alone, the inverted pages recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens, and rank their source page first 98.4% of the time. Shuffling and pooling both cut word recall to about 8%, a model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, and applied unchanged to a second multi-vector retriever the attack still ranks its source page first 70.2% of the time.
evidence: On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, pages inverted from raw indices recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens. Used as queries against the stored indices, they rank their source page first 98.4% of the time.

We test two cheap protections, token pooling and shuffling, which both cut word recall to about 8%. A model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, while inverting a pooled index remains open.

To test generalisation, we apply the same attack unchanged to another multi-vector retriever: its inverted pages still rank their source page first 70.2% of the time, though its word recall stays below a nearest-neighbour baseline.

highlights.why: Generation-aware latent compression maintains pretrained DiT compatibility, promising efficient high-quality video generation.

highlights.title: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation
highlights.authors: Zihan Su, Junhao Zhuang, Yaowei Li et al.
highlights.why: Decoupling gradient flows for context writing and denoising improves long-horizon autoregressive video generation without extra data.
highlights.key_result: Experiments on VBench over generation horizons of 5s, 60s, and 240s show that SGF+ achieves better visual quality and long-horizon consistency than SF and SGF in both framewise and chunkwise generation. With only 5s training rollouts, SGF+ supports continuous generation for up to 24 hours, without extending the training horizon or applying long-video fine-tuning.

highlights.title: Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together
highlights.authors: Jaeyeong Kim, Jinhyuk Jang, Jongmin Lee et al.
highlights.why: Explicitly conditions object generation on neighboring geometry and physics, enhancing scene-level coherence.
highlights.key_result: Tetris3D, a generative framework for single-image 3D scene reconstruction, recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability; the authors also introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations.
evidence: Moreover, we introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes featuring physical interactions across diverse object categories, with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations.

Comprehensive experiments on synthetic and real-world scenes show that Tetris3D recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability.

highlights.title: Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models Part 1.1: From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position
highlights.authors: Xiaoran Liu, Ziwei He, Xipeng Qiu
highlights.theme: Efficient LLM inference and long-context memory
highlights.why: Mechanistic analysis of hybrid attention-position interactions clarifies long-context extension and extrapolation trade-offs.
highlights.key_result: The paper proposes Sliding-Window Linear Attention, achieving 16× training-free length extrapolation while maintaining 100% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.
evidence: For LA hybrids, we summarize the Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation and propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention, achieving 16× training-free length extrapolation while maintaining 100% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.

highlights.title: On KL-Regularized Policy Optimization
highlights.theme: Test-time scaling and RLVR for reasoning
highlights.why: Provides a rigorous KL-regularized policy optimization framework that avoids importance clipping and critic training, useful for scalable RL.
highlights.key_result: The paper introduces KL-Regularized Policy Optimization (KLPO), which anchors the KL regularizer at the sampler and fits its log-ratio optimality condition by least squares on the sampler's own trajectories, yielding a critic-free update that uses one rollout per prompt and requires neither a learned normalizer nor a group of responses. It further proves that independent Monte Carlo estimates of the KL term keep these gradients unbiased and shows that SPPO, GPO, REBEL, and BPO arise as special cases of KLPO.
evidence: For token-level policy mirror descent targets, we show that the resulting gradient can be computed from terminal returns without a critic, via sampler-centered scores or a single trajectory residual, even under stochastic tool outputs.

We further prove that independent Monte Carlo estimates of the KL term keep these gradients unbiased, derive the exact KL gap of cheaper top-K and binary approximations, and show that SPPO, GPO, REBEL, and BPO arise as special cases of KLPO.
The result is a critic-free update that uses one rollout per prompt and requires neither a learned normalizer nor a group of responses.

news.summary: A three-month randomized controlled trial with 133 patent attorneys at eleven IP law firms found that AI access raised patent-drafting scores by 0.34 standard deviations at 10 days (a 10-percentile-point gain) and 0.38 SD at 90 days (11 percentile points), with gains coming from fewer poor scores and more good scores rather than more excellent ones. Effects on learning differed by seniority: senior lawyers who used AI for 90 days showed stronger judgment, while junior lawyers showed no average skill gain, with scores splitting into more strong and more low scores.

news.title: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games
news.summary: Google introduced Playground, an experimental browser-based platform where users create, play, and share custom games by describing them in text prompts, with no coding required. Games can be kept private, shared by link, or published to a community gallery with safety screenings, and it supports leaderboards and multiplayer in select genres; an integration with Unity Spark for more advanced mechanics and 3D capabilities is planned.

news.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, described as its cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model, costing on average around 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5 and available for high-volume tasks such as summarization, classification, and database queries. It is the first Haiku-class model with an adjustable effort setting; Anthropic also halved the price of Claude Sonnet 5.5 cache reads (about 20% cheaper on most agentic work) and introduced a monthly API credit for Claude Max and Team subscribers.

news.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
news.summary: Microsoft Research Asia released Agent Lightning v1.0, a Harnessed Agentic RL framework of roughly 3,500 lines of code that trains agents using their real deployment harness via an LLM proxy, with native Kubernetes support and no dependency on paid commercial sandbox services. An end-to-end coding agent pipeline raised Qwen3.5-9B from 41.8% to 56.4% Pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified (a 14.6 percentage point gain) using about 6,000 training samples.

news.title: NVIDIA, Microsoft Kick Off a New Beginning for Windows PCs With RTX Spark and AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft announced RTX Spark for Windows laptops and compact desktops, combining a Blackwell RTX GPU with up to 6,144 cores and up to a 20-core Grace CPU connected at 600 GB/s, delivering up to one petaflop of FP4 AI performance and up to 128GB unified memory. Laptop preorders opened with availability October 16 and compact desktops in November; Microsoft also announced general availability of Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC), and the Surface Laptop Ultra was built around RTX Spark.

news.title: The Machines that Make the Machines
news.summary: NVIDIA's Seattle Robotics Lab and Isaac engineering team developed robotic systems to assemble GB300 tester trays, targeting busbar assembly and multi-connector insertion. A classical modular pipeline using FoundationPose, Lissajous-curve waypoint primitives, and an impedance controller achieved over 95% success on busbar assembly with a 160-second cycle time; connector grasping used a new pose-estimation framework called DOPER, and insertion policies were pretrained in Isaac Lab with sim-to-real RL then refined via SPARR residual training with force-torque inputs.

news.title: Validate AI Factory Changes with Digital Twins and AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA described using NVIDIA DSX Air, a node-based digital twin of AI factory infrastructure and software interfaces, together with NVIDIA Brev on-demand GPU compute, to validate configurations and software changes before hardware arrives. Agentic workflows interrogate the twin, run configuration checks, compare outcomes against policy, and produce evidence-backed recommendations within a governed loop, with the NVIDIA AI Blueprint for Video Search and Summarization demonstrating the pattern.

news.title: Scaling Decision Optimization to 100 Million Variables and Beyond with mPDLP in NVIDIA cuOpt
news.summary: NVIDIA cuOpt introduced mPDLP, a multi-GPU Primal-Dual hybrid gradient LP solver that distributes problems across NVLink-connected GPUs, achieving up to 6x lower peak memory per GPU versus single-GPU PDLP (with problems capped at 2.1B nonzeros) and up to 11.4x speedups on PDLP steps for the largest problems. Benchmarks on over 100 LP instances using DGX B200 GPUs showed 1.2x to 2.5x speedups over D-PDLP on most large instances above 10^7 nonzeros; Kinaxis reported 3.3x speedup on a 135M-variable supply chain model on eight H100s and PSR over 5x on a 185M-variable energy model on eight B200s.

news.title: Faster Scientific Image Analysis with NVIDIA cuPhoton
news.summary: NVIDIA released cuPhoton, an open-source CUDA-X toolkit with GPU-accelerated modules (xDataReader, xRep, xPois, xFit, xScan) for loading, aligning, and analyzing scientific images while keeping data on the GPU from sensor read through classification. On multi-GPU representative workloads it accelerated image loading by up to 14,900x and signal processing by up to 14,550x versus an x86 CPU baseline, and can process data from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's LSSTCam, which produces 3.2-gigapixel exposures every 39 seconds and up to 20 terabytes and 10 million candidate objects per night within a 60-to-120-second alert window.

news.title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
news.summary: Hugging Face released two open decision models, d1-3B and d1-omni-600M (experimental), built on Liquid Foundation Models and answering in a single forward pass rather than generating tokens. d1-3B scores 48.57 on the Decision Index 0.2.1 and answers a question in 16 ms on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, 26 ms on a Jetson AGX Orin, and 50 ms on an Orin Nano, with a mean score of 82.9 across seven datasets; d1-omni-600M scores 78.4 and supports text with images or audio.

news.title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
news.summary: Hugging Face reported that fine-tuned Nemotron models reached gold-medal level at both IMO 2026 and IOI 2026: Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC with SFT and GenCorrect scored 535.4/600 at IOI, above the 361.12 gold threshold and the top human score of 498.27, and a Nemotron 3 Ultra generate-verify-refine system scored 30/42 at IMO, above the official gold threshold of 29. Training used 22,000 curated competitive-programming problems and an SFT corpus of 414,890 examples across 15,818 unique proof problems, with RL on 9,597 proof problems.

news.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS
news.summary: AWS announced availability of Claude Haiku 5.5 on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS, describing it as the fastest and most efficient model in the Claude 5.5 family for subagents and high-volume, cost-sensitive work, at around 75 percent less cost than Claude Haiku 4.5 for most tasks. It is the first Haiku model with effort controls, and AWS positions it as pairing with Claude Opus 5.5, which handles planning and judgment calls.

news.title: Rethinking access control for RAG with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: AWS described adding real-time access control list enforcement for RAG on Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, checking permissions directly with the authoritative source at query time rather than relying on replicated ACL attributes. The post identifies three weaknesses of the replicate-and-filter approach: the AI system is not the source of truth, stale permissions from pull-based syncs create security gaps, and evolving data source permission models can break ACL mapping.

news.title: Beyond hours saved: Building the business case for agentic automation
news.summary: AWS proposed an Agentic Value Model for justifying agentic automation investments, arguing the RPA-era ROI formula of hours saved times labor cost minus build cost misses most agent value. The framework measures time savings, exception handling, decision quality, and change resilience and maintenance economics, citing AWS planning ranges that correcting an error can cost 1.5–4 times the original transaction and that human error can account for 2–15 percent of operational cost, and a McKinsey "1:3:5 pattern" of spending per dollar invested.

news.title: How Qlik built grounded, enterprise-scale AI with Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Qlik built Qlik Answers, a grounded enterprise AI product running on Amazon Bedrock and generally available since February 2026, serving more than 40,000 customers and with its Discovery Agent surfacing more than 100,000 discoveries since launch. Cited deployments include Bystronic, which stood up an AI chatbot in 15 minutes; Lintech International, which indexed more than 17,000 technical documents and sped responses by 75 percent, returning as much as 7 hours a week to managers; and TouchPoint Support Services, serving 650 healthcare sites with 15,000 staff.

themes.name: 视觉-语言-动作模型与操作
themes.summary: 这些论文构建用于机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作策略及支持模块，提出了在执行过程中协调新指令、桥接感知与动作、调节视觉令牌影响、对齐分词器码本、认证加速以及使编排器与策略协同演化的方法。若干工作将视觉-语言模型应用于具体任务，如农业喷洒、水果采摘、家庭辅助和物体所有权归属。它们的不同之处在于，是关注策略的内部表示、推理流程还是周围的智能体系统。

themes.name: 安全对齐、遗忘与隐私
themes.summary: 这些论文考察语言模型和智能体中安全机制的鲁棒性与治理，涵盖保护隐私的联邦微调、凭证泄露基准、自适应护栏、运行时验证、安全参数的稀疏故障分析以及通过 KV 缓存持续存在的攻击。其他工作研究信息移除后开放权重模型的抗篡改性，以及人工审核或报告激励如何影响安全决策。它们的不同之处在于关注训练时隐私、推理时护栏或对抗性持续存在。

themes.name: 机器人世界模型与 3D/4D 重建
themes.summary: 这些论文开发世界模型和重建方法，为机器人和场景构建持久性的空间或几何表示，涵盖因子图和场景图综述、流式全景和高斯重建、用于控制的有向时间表示以及点云去噪。其他工作侧重于 CAD 重建、贝塞尔曲线拓扑推理、几何感知渲染，以及诊断机器人世界模型中的故障不敏感性。它们的不同之处在于建模动力学与控制、重建几何，还是整理场景数据。

themes.name: 自改进与多智能体 LLM 系统
themes.summary: 这些论文研究通过经验自我改进的智能体和多智能体系统，涵盖智能体技能的下游效用、自我改进度量、编码中的判断工程、并行推理中的不确定性估计以及开放式科学发现。若干工作使用搜索循环和元智能体自动化提示、工作流乃至强化学习算法的演化，而其他工作则构建可复用代码原语或将论文转化为可训练代码。它们的不同之处在于度量、编排还是自动化智能体改进。

themes.name: 高效 LLM 推理与长上下文记忆
themes.summary: 这些论文针对长上下文推理和持久记忆的成本与可靠性，提出了带有时间预取的 KV 缓存压缩、稀疏注意力索引、自剪枝注意力以及循环模型的动态计算。其他工作研究记忆提交规则、跨模型漂移、冲突解决评分，以及长期记忆问答中的证据缺口。它们的不同之处在于优化注意力和缓存效率，还是审计已存储记忆的行为。

themes.name: 用于推理与科学的扩散和流模型
themes.summary: 这些论文将扩散和流匹配生成模型应用于科学与推理问题，包括脑电图去噪、掩码和连续扩散语言模型、CT 重建、跳跃扩散转移核、格点规范理论采样以及逆问题。若干工作引入重掩码、提示加噪、一致性蒸馏和池化表示自编码器，以提高样本质量或效率。它们的不同之处在于处理语言生成、物理模拟还是逆问题后验采样。

themes.name: LLM 评判可靠性及基准审计
themes.summary: 这些论文审计评估流程的有效性和可靠性，质疑预测基准中的预处理、任务验证器的盲区、LLM 评判的聚合准确性，以及量子优化器比较中的报告惯例。其他工作研究 AI 评估生态系统、基于客户反馈的智能体 harness，以及编码智能体基准与真实任务流程的对比，并提出针对思维链验证器的条件准确率画像和可认证弃权。它们的不同之处在于诊断评判器、验证器还是更广泛的基准生态系统。

themes.name: 医学影像基础模型
themes.summary: 这些论文构建和适应用于医学影像任务的基础模型，如报告生成、纵向疾病演变、病理校准、脑 MRI 修复和心脏电影合成。若干工作关注可解释性和个性化，使用概念瓶颈、从部署经验中学习且与模型无关的方法，或审计患者特定预测，而其他工作则从稀疏 X 射线重建 CT。它们的不同之处在于适应基础模型、生成缺失模态还是审计临床个性化。

themes.name: 测试时扩展与用于推理的 RLVR
themes.summary: 这些论文通过推理时和强化学习方法改进推理，提出过程条件自一致性、best-of-N 评估、rollout 分配以及快速模型与深思模型之间的系统切换。其他工作侧重于在线策略蒸馏、KL 正则化和离线策略校正的策略优化，以及它们对技能传授与知识传授的影响。它们的不同之处在于扩展测试时采样、蒸馏监督还是校正异步强化学习。

themes.name: 图 RAG 与结构化数据基础模型
themes.summary: 这些论文在结构化知识之上构建检索和推理系统，包括用于临床风险的本体基础 GraphRAG、多模态 GraphRAG 基准、功能感知检索，以及用于神经科学靶点、原子间势和机器学习模型的知识图谱。其他工作研究视觉文档检索蒸馏、客户上下文图、检索增强模型中的归因，以及可证明私密的表格分类。它们的不同之处在于构建知识图谱、评估 GraphRAG 还是将结构化检索应用于某个领域。

themes.name: Transformer 的机制可解释性
themes.summary: 这些论文探究 Transformer 的内部机制，追踪 AlphaFold 中的结构信息、微型模型中的算术草稿、跨模型激活对齐、空间归纳头以及多语言多跳路由头。其他工作研究 RoPE 中的逐层幅值、否定行为、归一化注意力的可辨识性、秩坍缩、高斯等价性以及激活修补造成的损害。它们的不同之处在于识别回路、分析表示几何还是检验理论性质。

themes.name: 语音适应与情感
themes.summary: 这些论文在不同领域和条件下对语音模型进行适应和控制，涵盖儿童 ASR 适应并保留成人性能、说话人分离适应掩蔽、隐私评估指标、音素引导初始化、口型同步评分、方言鲁棒语言模型和上下文偏置。其他工作涉及口音语言识别、参数高效 Whisper 适应以及生成语音中情感的激活引导。它们的不同之处在于改善识别鲁棒性、控制表现力还是评估适应性。

highlights.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
highlights.authors: Wei Huang, Bohan Zhang, Chenzhi Liu et al.
highlights.why: 强有力的结果表明，自回归预训练解锁了长上下文世界-动作模型，推动了实时机器人控制的发展。
highlights.key_result: 我们的核心发现是，访问历史并不等同于利用历史：当视频基础模型以自回归方式（AR）预训练时，更长的历史带来的益处要大得多。在 RoboCasa GR-1 上，将上下文从 0.0 秒增加到 19.2 秒，成功率从 63.3% 提高到 78.7%，而双向预训练的初始化没有净收益；机器人领域的 AR 预训练进一步提高了 GR-1 和 LIBERO-Long 上的峰值成功率；Long-WAM 还在 LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0 和 DOMINO 上取得了对比方法中的最佳结果，现实世界部署包括动态杯子堆叠任务上 95% 的成功率。
evidence: Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long.
Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO.
Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where _0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials.

highlights.title: Inverting Multi-Vector Visual Document Indices
highlights.authors: Zhuchenyang Liu, Yao Zhang, Yu Xiao
highlights.why: 证明了多向量视觉文档索引可以被倒排以恢复单词并识别来源页面，构成重大隐私风险。
highlights.key_result: 仅从存储的原始索引中，倒排页面就能恢复 47% 的单词和 45% 的敏感词元，并且在 98.4% 的情况下将其来源页面排在第一位。打乱和池化都将单词召回率降低到约 8%，一个恢复打乱索引顺序的模型将来源页面排名第一的比例从 3.8% 提高到 93.5%，并且将该攻击原封不动地应用于第二个多向量检索器时，它仍然在 70.2% 的情况下将其来源页面排在第一位。
evidence: On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, pages inverted from raw indices recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens. Used as queries against the stored indices, they rank their source page first 98.4% of the time.

We test two cheap protections, token pooling and shuffling, which both cut word recall to about 8%. A model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, while inverting a pooled index remains open.

To test generalisation, we apply the same attack unchanged to another multi-vector retriever: its inverted pages still rank their source page first 70.2% of the time, though its word recall stays below a nearest-neighbour baseline.

highlights.title: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
highlights.authors: Jiyoung Kim, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Jisu Nam et al.
highlights.why: 生成感知的潜在压缩保持了预训练 DiT 的兼容性，有望实现高效的高质量视频生成。
highlights.key_result: GRACE 在 480×832 分辨率、81 帧条件下，将 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 的令牌数量减少近 8 倍，延迟降低 11.1 倍，同时与压缩前预训练流程的 VBench 生成质量相当；加速比随分辨率提高而增大，在 736×1280 下达到 15.5 倍。
evidence: GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by nearly 8 and its latency by 11.1 at 480 832 resolution with 81 frames, while matching the VBench generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression.

Our method reduces the token count of Wan2.1-14B by nearly 8 and end-to-end generation latency by 11.1 at 480 832 81, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench (Fig. ), compressing both axes at once to 16 spatial and 8 temporal. The gain grows with resolution, reaching 15.5 at 736 1280 81.

GRACE matches the VBench generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on Wan2.1-I2V-14B while running 11.1 faster at 480 832 81, and the speedup grows with resolution, reaching 15.5 at 736 1280 81.

highlights.title: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation
highlights.authors: Zihan Su, Junhao Zhuang, Yaowei Li et al.
highlights.why: 将上下文写入与去噪的梯度流解耦，无需额外数据即可改善长时程自回归视频生成。
highlights.key_result: 在 VBench 上针对 5 秒、60 秒和 240 秒生成时长的实验表明，SGF+ 在逐帧和逐块生成中均比 SF 和 SGF 实现了更好的视觉质量和长时程一致性。仅使用 5 秒的训练 rollout，SGF+ 即可支持长达 24 小时的连续生成，而无需延长训练时长或应用长视频微调。
evidence: Experiments on VBench over generation horizons of 5s, 60s, and 240s show that SGF+ achieves better visual quality and long-horizon consistency than SF and SGF in both framewise and chunkwise generation.
With only 5s training rollouts, SGF+ supports continuous generation for up to 24 hours, without extending the training horizon or applying long-video fine-tuning.

highlights.title: Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together
highlights.authors: Jaeyeong Kim, Jinhyuk Jang, Jongmin Lee et al.
highlights.why: 明确地以邻近几何和物理为条件生成物体，增强了场景级一致性。
highlights.key_result: Tetris3D 是一个用于单图像 3D 场景重建的生成框架，即使在交互区域被遮挡时也能恢复一致的物体形状和姿态，并在生成质量和物理稳定性两方面都达到了最先进的性能；作者还引入了 ComOb，一个基于物理模拟的数据集，包含 1.2M 个场景，每个物体都有网格和成对物理关系标注。
evidence: Moreover, we introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes featuring physical interactions across diverse object categories, with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations.

Comprehensive experiments on synthetic and real-world scenes show that Tetris3D recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability.

highlights.title: Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models Part 1.1: From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position
highlights.authors: Xiaoran Liu, Ziwei He, Xipeng Qiu
highlights.theme: Efficient LLM inference and long-context memory
highlights.why: 对混合注意力-位置交互的机制分析阐明了长上下文扩展与外推之间的权衡。
highlights.key_result: 本文提出了滑窗线性注意力（Sliding-Window Linear Attention），实现了 16 倍的无训练长度外推，同时在 64k 上下文长度下在 NIAH-SK1 上保持了 100% 的准确率。
evidence: For LA hybrids, we summarize the Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation and propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention, achieving 16× training-free length extrapolation while maintaining 100% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.
For LA hybrids, we propose the Sliding-Window Linear Attention, achieving 16× training-free extrapolation with 100% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.

highlights.title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
highlights.authors: Zhiqin Yang, Chenxin Li, Xiaomeng Hu et al.
highlights.why: 一个跨具身形态的具有挑战性的多模态基准，揭示了机器人智能体在组合能力上的差距。
highlights.key_result: 在所有五个模型中，任务完成率仍然有限：Astra 完成了 84 个任务中的 16 个（19.0%），随后是 Opus 5.5 完成 13 个（15.5%），Kimi K3 完成 2 个（2.4%），DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash 各完成 1 个（1.2%）。Astra 比 Opus 5.5 多完成三个任务，即 3.6 个百分点，但即使得分最高的模型也留下了 68 个任务未完成。
evidence: Task completion remains limited across all five models. As shown in Figure , Astra completes 16 of 84 tasks (19.0%), followed by Opus 5.5 with 13 (15.5%), Kimi K3 with 2 (2.4%), and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash with 1 each (1.2%). Astra leads Opus 5.5 by three tasks, or 3.6 percentage points, but even the highest-scoring model leaves 68 tasks unfinished.

highlights.title: On KL-Regularized Policy Optimization
highlights.theme: Test-time scaling and RLVR for reasoning
highlights.why: 提供了一种严格的 KL 正则化策略优化框架，避免了重要性裁剪和评论家训练，适用于可扩展的强化学习。
highlights.key_result: 本文提出了 KL 正则化策略优化（KLPO），它将 KL 正则项锚定在采样器上，并通过在采样器自身轨迹上的最小二乘拟合其对数比最优性条件，产生一种无评论家的更新，每个提示仅使用一次 rollout，既不要求学习到的归一化器也不需要一组响应。进一步证明了 KL 项的独立蒙特卡洛估计使这些梯度保持无偏，并表明 SPPO、GPO、REBEL 和 BPO 是 KLPO 的特殊情形。
evidence: For token-level policy mirror descent targets, we show that the resulting gradient can be computed from terminal returns without a critic, via sampler-centered scores or a single trajectory residual, even under stochastic tool outputs.

We further prove that independent Monte Carlo estimates of the KL term keep these gradients unbiased, derive the exact KL gap of cheaper top-K and binary approximations, and show that SPPO, GPO, REBEL, and BPO arise as special cases of KLPO.
The result is a critic-free update that uses one rollout per prompt and requires neither a learned normalizer nor a group of responses.

Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
Does better work always mean better workers?
news.summary: 一项为期三个月的随机对照试验涉及 11 家知识产权律师事务所的 133 名专利律师，结果发现，使用 AI 使专利撰写得分在 10 天后提高了 0.34 个标准差（即 10 个百分位点的提升），在 90 天后提高了 0.38 个标准差（11 个百分位点），提升主要来自低分减少和高分增加，而非优秀得分增加。对学习的影响因资历而异：使用 AI 90 天的高级律师表现出更强的判断力，而初级律师则没有平均技能提升，其得分分化为更多的高分和低分。

news.title: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games
news.summary: Google 推出了 Playground，这是一个基于浏览器的实验性平台，用户可以通过文本提示描述来创建、游玩和分享自定义游戏，无需编写代码。游戏可以保持私密、通过链接分享，或发布到经过安全筛查的社区画廊，并且支持排行榜和特定类型的多人游戏；计划与 Unity Spark 集成以提供更高级的机制和 3D 功能。

news.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
news.summary: Anthropic 发布了 Claude Haiku 5.5，称其是该公司最便宜、最快、能力最强的小型模型，运行成本平均比 Haiku 4.5 低约 75%，可用于摘要、分类和数据库查询等大批量任务。这是首款具有可调 effort 设置的 Haiku 级模型；Anthropic 还将 Claude Sonnet 5.5 缓存读取的价格减半（在大多数智能体工作中约便宜 20%），并为 Claude Max 和 Team 订阅者引入了每月 API 信用额度。

news.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
news.summary: 微软亚洲研究院发布了 Agent Lightning v1.0，一个 Harnessed Agentic RL 框架，约 3,500 行代码，通过 LLM 代理使用真实部署 harness 训练智能体，原生支持 Kubernetes，且不依赖付费商业沙盒服务。一个端到端编码智能体流程使用约 6,000 个训练样本，将 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的 Pass@1 从 41.8% 提高到 56.4%（提升了 14.6 个百分点）。

news.title: NVIDIA, Microsoft Kick Off a New Beginning for Windows PCs With RTX Spark and AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft announced RTX Spark for Windows laptops and compact desktops, combining a Blackwell RTX GPU with up to 6,144 cores and up to a 20-core Grace CPU connected at 600 GB/s, delivering up to one petaflop of FP4 AI performance and up to 128GB unified memory. Laptop preorders opened with availability October 16 and compact desktops in November; Microsoft also announced general availability of Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC), and the Surface Laptop Ultra was built around RTX Spark.

news.title: The Machines that Make the Machines
news.summary: NVIDIA 西雅图机器人实验室和 Isaac 工程团队开发了用于组装 GB300 测试托盘的机器人系统，目标是母线排组装和多连接器插入。一个经典模块化流程使用 FoundationPose、利萨如曲线路径点基元和阻抗控制器，在母线排组装上实现了超过 95% 的成功率，周期时间为 160 秒；连接器抓取使用了一种名为 DOPER 的新型姿态估计框架，插入策略先在 Isaac Lab 中通过从仿真到现实的强化学习进行预训练，然后通过 SPARR 残差训练并结合力-力矩输入进行优化。

news.title: Validate AI Factory Changes with Digital Twins and AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 描述了使用 NVIDIA DSX Air（一种基于节点的 AI 工厂基础设施和软件接口数字孪生）以及 NVIDIA Brev 按需 GPU 计算，在硬件到位之前验证配置和软件更改。智能体工作流会询问孪生体、运行配置检查、将结果与策略进行比较，并在受治理的循环中生成有证据支持的建议，NVIDIA AI Blueprint for Video Search and Summarization 展示了这一模式。

news.title: Scaling Decision Optimization to 100 Million Variables and Beyond with mPDLP in NVIDIA cuOpt
news.summary: NVIDIA cuOpt introduced mPDLP, a multi-GPU Primal-Dual hybrid gradient LP solver that distributes problems across NVLink-connected GPUs, achieving up to 6x lower peak memory per GPU versus single-GPU PDLP (with problems capped at 2.1B nonzeros) and up to 11.4x speedups on PDLP steps for the largest problems. Benchmarks on over 100 LP instances using DGX B200 GPUs showed 1.2x to 2.5x speedups over D-PDLP on most large instances above 10^7 nonzeros; Kinaxis reported 3.3x speedup on a 135M-variable supply chain model on eight H100s and PSR over 5x on a 185M-variable energy model on eight B200s.

news.title: Faster Scientific Image Analysis with NVIDIA cuPhoton
news.summary: NVIDIA released cuPhoton, an open-source CUDA-X toolkit with GPU-accelerated modules (xDataReader, xRep, xPois, xFit, xScan) for loading, aligning, and analyzing scientific images while keeping data on the GPU from sensor read through classification. On multi-GPU representative workloads it accelerated image loading by up to 14,900x and signal processing by up to 14,550x versus an x86 CPU baseline, and can process data from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's LSSTCam, which produces 3.2-gigapixel exposures every 39 seconds and up to 20 terabytes and 10 million candidate objects per night within a 60-to-120-second alert window.

news.title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
news.summary: Hugging Face 发布了两款开放式决策模型 d1-3B 和 d1-omni-600M（实验性），它们基于 Liquid Foundation Models 构建，以单次前向传播直接给出答案，而不是生成令牌。d1-3B 在 Decision Index 0.2.1 上得分为 48.57，在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor 上回答一个问题需要 16 毫秒，在 Jetson AGX Orin 上需要 26 毫秒，在 Orin Nano 上需要 50 毫秒，在七个数据集上的平均得分为 82.9；d1-omni-600M 得分为 78.4，并支持文本与图像或音频输入。

news.title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
news.summary: Hugging Face 报告称，经过微调的 Nemotron 模型在 IMO 2026 和 IOI 2026 上均达到金牌水平：采用 SFT 和 GenCorrect 的 Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC 在 IOI 上得分为 535.4/600，高于 361.12 的金牌阈值和 498.27 的人类最高分；一个 Nemotron 3 Ultra 生成-验证-优化系统在 IMO 上得分为 30/42，高于官方金牌阈值 29。训练使用了 22,000 个精选的竞赛编程题，以及包含 15,818 个独特证明问题、共 414,890 个样本的 SFT 语料库，并在 9,597 个证明问题上进行了强化学习。

news.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS
news.summary: AWS 宣布 Claude Haiku 5.5 已在 Amazon Bedrock 和 AWS 上的 Claude Platform 可用，并称其为 Claude 5.5 系列中速度最快、效率最高的模型，适用于子智能体和大规模、成本敏感的工作，对于大多数任务，其成本比 Claude Haiku 4.5 低约 75%。这是首款具有 effort 控制的 Haiku 模型，AWS 将其定位为与 Claude Opus 5.5 搭配使用，后者负责规划和判断。

news.title: Rethinking access control for RAG with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: AWS 描述了为 Amazon Quick 和 Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases 上的 RAG 增加实时访问控制列表（ACL）强制执行功能，在查询时直接向权威来源核实权限，而不是依赖复制的 ACL 属性。该文章指出了复制-过滤方法的三个弱点：AI 系统不是事实来源，基于拉取的同步导致权限过期从而产生安全漏洞，以及数据源权限模型的变化可能破坏 ACL 映射。

news.title: Beyond hours saved: Building the business case for agentic automation
news.summary: AWS 提出了一个智能体价值模型（Agentic Value Model），用于论证智能体自动化投资的合理性，认为 RPA 时代的 ROI 公式（节省的小时数乘以劳动力成本减去构建成本）遗漏了大部分智能体价值。该框架衡量时间节省、异常处理、决策质量以及变更弹性和维护经济性，引用 AWS 的规划范围指出，纠正一个错误的成本可能是原始交易的 1.5–4 倍，人为错误可能占运营成本的 2–15%，以及 McKinsey 的“1:3:5 模式”，即每投入一美元的花费模式。

news.title: How Qlik built grounded, enterprise-scale AI with Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Qlik built Qlik Answers, a grounded enterprise AI product running on Amazon Bedrock and generally available since February 2026, serving more than 40,000 customers and with its Discovery Agent surfacing more than 100,000 discoveries since launch. Cited deployments include Bystronic, which stood up an AI chatbot in 15 minutes; Lintech International, which indexed more than 17,000 technical documents and sped responses by 75 percent, returning as much as 7 hours a week to managers; and TouchPoint Support Services, serving 650 healthcare sites with 15,000 staff.
